name: AI Recipe: Satirical News
description: Claude writes one deadpan, Onion-style article under the masthead The Overcorrect, rotating across twelve beats and optionally anchored on a real current story, with a metadata sidecar and, when an image key is set, a cover, a square thumbnail and two in-article illustrations.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips all four pictures; the article still publishes.

author: ai-automation-tools
